meta.description: Catalog of movable items with loaded volume (m3), dimensions, weight and handling flags; apartment-type volume presets; vehicle list. Research draft R2. Every value is a placeholder until checked by the company (verified:false).

units.dimensions: cm (w = width, d = depth, h = height, as the item normally stands)

meta.volumeConvention: volumeM3 = space the item takes in the cargo area, following cube-sheet / Umzugsgutliste convention (already includes typical air around the item). NOT the geometric WxDxH product. Apply loadFactor on top (see docs/research/02-volume.md).

source.note: Average packing 70-80% efficient, professional 90-95%. German movers advise +10-15% reserve (askotrans-umzug.de / sanier.de, search-result summaries). Default 1.10 is an assumption for a professional crew applied to cube-sheet values.
US industry convention 7 lb per cubic foot = 112 kg/m3, average over a whole shipment of household goods, not per item.

canStandOnEnd.yes: can be carried/placed vertically (on its short side) in an elevator or on stairs without risk
canStandOnEnd.no: must stay in its normal orientation (or must not be stood on end)
canStandOnEnd.caution: possible for a short time with care; see notes

meta.heavyRule: heavy = true when weightKg >= 50 or the item needs 2+ people / special equipment. Assumption.
meta.researchCaveat: WebFetch was blocked in the research environment; values were taken from web-search result summaries of the cited pages. Each value must be checked against the source (or measured by the company) before setting verified:true.

roomPresets.note: Total loaded volume BEFORE loadFactor, including boxes, excluding kitchen cabinets (in Romania kitchen furniture usually stays). min/max ~ p10/p90 guess; typical = point estimate. Romanian naming: 'camere' counts living room + bedrooms (kitchen and bathroom not counted).
